responseMessageContents.text:
Here's what I've added:

**Stats Dashboard (Profile tab):**
- Overall progress card with animated progress bar showing % of all peaks completed
- 4 stat cards: Summits, Meters Gained, Countries Visited, Ranges Climbed
- Highest summit highlight card
- Difficulty breakdown chips (Extreme, Hard, Moderate, etc.)
- Animated category progress bars
- Recent summits list with per-summit share buttons

**Social Sharing:**
- **Share all stats** — tap the share icon in the top-right of the Dashboard to share your full stats (summit count, elevation, countries, category progress)
- **Share individual summit** — from the mountain detail page (share icon in top bar when summited, or "Share Summit" button in the summit tab), or from the recent summits list on the dashboard
- Shares a formatted text message with mountain emoji, name, elevation, date, and your report excerpt

responseMessageContents.title: Add a progress dashboard and sharing features
responseMessageContents.description: You can now view your total climbing stats, such as mountains climbed and total elevation, on a new dashboard. I also added buttons to share your summits and overall progress with friends.
